definition: Risk-managed rollout patterns: canary sends a small traffic slice to the new version and watches metrics before ramping; shadow runs the new version on real traffic without serving its outputs.
details: Risk-managed rollout patterns: canary sends a small traffic slice to the new version and watches metrics before ramping; shadow runs the new version on real traffic without serving its outputs. Standard practice for model and prompt upgrades, because offline evals never cover everything.
